Merge Versions

Movies that exist in several resolutions become one library entry, and the highest resolution plays first. TV series are never touched.

merge

How a merge works

The result box follows your saved settings.

Example

movieTwo files Dune: Part Two (2024) 3840 px/movies-4k/Dune Part Two (2024)1920 px/movies/Dune Part Two (2024)
keySame movie? Same TMDb ID Falls back to the IMDb ID. Never matched by title and year.
check_circleResult One entry · 2 versions 3840 px is the primary version. The version picker on the movie page offers both.
  • movieMovies only. TV series are never touched.
  • starThe widest picture (most pixels across) becomes the primary version.
  • groupVersions that not every user can see, or with different production years, stay separate.
  • refreshExisting merges with a lower-resolution primary are rebuilt.
tune

Options

Used by every run: hourly, at startup, after the library goes quiet, and Run now.

Mode
Rebuilds existing merges where a lower resolution is currently the primary version.

schedule

When it runs

Read from the scheduled task. Runs after the library goes quiet are not listed in the task history; they show in the log.

description

What the runs did

Every run writes its result to the Jellyfin log, in lines that start with "MKI Merge". In a dry run, that is where you see what would be merged.
